description: The trade rulebook for one country by its two-letter code (uk for the United Kingdom): market status, who can trade, customs and duty, labelling, age and sale limits, protected names, GTIN authority, and open items and as-of date; each section lists its official sources, and a part with no official source says "Not yet sourced".

code.description: two-letter country code as the Library writes it, for example es, uk, jp

name: get_rulebook
